title: Alexandria… Why?
posterAlt: Poster of the film Alexandria… Why?
synopsis: A semi-autobiographical portrait of Alexandria during the Second World War, seen through a young man who lives for the cinema. It is the film to watch before you walk the Corniche.

title: The Mummy
posterAlt: Poster of the film The Mummy
synopsis: A swashbuckling treasure hunt through a lost city, a curse and a race across the Egyptian desert. Not a documentary, but it captures the thrill of going somewhere nobody has been.

title: River of Love (Nahr el-Hob)
posterAlt: Poster of the film River of Love
synopsis: A lavish melodrama about forbidden love in Egyptian high society, adapted from Tolstoy's Anna Karenina and starring Faten Hamama and Omar Sharif.

title: The Night of Counting the Years (Al-Mummia)
posterAlt: Poster of the film The Night of Counting the Years
synopsis: A slow, hushed drama set in Upper Egypt about a family guarding a secret tomb. Its long silences and wide landscapes suit a quiet evening.
